8ug8ear.text: You have bleached-blond hair swept up into a tall, spiky crest. Dark teal markings run across your forehead, cheeks and chin, with matching teal eyeshadow. You wear a rust-red jacket with brass buckle straps.

aaron.text: You have short black hair cut close to the head and a broad, solid build. You wear a yellow-green mottled leather jacket with silver buckle straps over a grey graphic T-shirt. A red and blue patch is sewn on the chest of the jacket.

adam-smasher.text: You are a towering cyborg with a bald, chrome-plated head and a metal face with glowing red optics. Your body is covered in heavy black armoured plating, with a shield-shaped chest plate. Red-lit cabling runs across your shoulders and neck.

alan-noel.text: You wear a close-fitting teal hood with circuit-like traces and a small device clipped to the side of your head. A sleeveless grey-white vest with a zip front sits over dark knit sleeves, and one of your hands is chrome. Red-trimmed armour guards your forearms.

alex.text: You have short hair swept back, dyed red at the front and blonde on top, with a septum ring and freckles across your face. You wear a red open jacket over a grey shirt, with a beaded necklace and beaded bracelets on your wrists.

alt-cunningham.text: You have long, loose light-brown hair and a steady gaze. You wear a dark leather jacket with bright piping over a white top, with a pendant on a chain at your neck. Your right hand is chrome cyberware with a studded black cuff.

ana-friedman.text: You have dark hair pulled up into a high bun with a few loose strands. You wear an olive-khaki button-up shirt, open over a grey tank top, with the sleeves rolled up. Your expression is steady and unsmiling.

arthur-jenkins.text: You have short, dark, slicked-back hair and a clean-shaven face. You wear a charcoal suit with a white shirt and a red-and-black striped tie. A small dark mark sits on your forehead.

babs-okoye.text: You have a full mass of dark, coiled hair and a lean, muscular build. You wear a yellow-green tactical vest over black armoured pads and fingerless gloves, with a yellow spray-painted B on one shoulder pad. A dark tattoo runs down your forearm.

bill-mitchell.text: You have short, closely cropped dark hair and a stocky frame. You wear a bright blue NCPD polo shirt with white NCPD lettering, and a police ID badge hangs from a chain around your neck. One of your arms is a blue-trimmed cybernetic arm, and thin marks run across your cheeks.

blue-moon.text: You have bright turquoise hair gathered into two bun-style buns, with blunt bangs across your forehead. You wear an orange spiked collar over a blue ribbed tank top. Small dark marks sit beside your eyes.

bob-sagan.text: You have a dark cap with a diamond-shaped badge on the front, and a thick moustache with a goatee. You have broad shoulders and wear a dark leather harness with straps over a grey top.

briana-dolson.text: You have a short black bob with blunt bangs and rimless glasses. You wear a dark denim sleeveless vest covered in round pin badges over a maroon striped shirt. One of your arms is a mechanical cyberarm with exposed chrome parts and an orange housing.

carol-emeka.text: You have dark, shoulder-length hair swept back from your face. You wear red-tinted sunglasses and a dark sleeveless top layered over a grey knit sleeve. A dark strap runs across your chest.

cassidy-righter.text: You wear a dark brown cowboy hat and have a thick brown moustache. You wear a brown-and-black plaid shirt under a brown leather jacket with dark straps across the chest.

chang-hoon-nam.text: You have short, dark, messy hair and a broad face. A cybernetic optic sits over one of your eyes, with a red-tinted lens. You wear a dark green-grey jacket with dark purple buttons over a light teal shirt.

claire-russell.text: You have shoulder-length auburn hair worn loose and pushed back, with a small gold star hoop in one ear. You wear a red ribbed tank top with a grey backpack strap over it, and layered gold and black necklaces with a cross pendant.

coach-fred.text: You are bald and very muscular, with a broad chest and thick arms. You wear a bright orange sleeveless tank top with a deep scoop neckline. Your skin has a warm, bronzed tone.

cynthia-najarro.text: You have sleek light-brown hair pulled tightly back from your face, and you wear tinted aviator sunglasses. Large gold hoop earrings and a thin gold bracelet catch the light. You wear a fitted magenta blazer over a cream collared shirt.

dakota-smith.text: You have dark hair that falls in loose waves past your shoulders. You wear a grey top with a green knit sleeve on one arm, and a dark tattoo covers your forearm. A small mechanical gadget is attached near your wrist.

dennis-cranmer.text: You have short, spiky dark hair with reddish tips. You wear round wire-rimmed glasses and a grey, high-collared jacket over a button-front shirt.

dexter-deshawn.text: You have a bald head with long braids falling down the back and sides, and a full dark beard. You wear rectangular red-tinted sunglasses and a red-brown chain necklace that catches the light. A dark leather jacket covers your shoulders.

dino-dinovic.text: You have a mohawk with dark green-tipped hair and shaved sides, with a dark stripe across one side of your head. You wear tinted aviator glasses, a septum ring, and a dark painted mark on your cheek and chin. Your outfit is a black studded leather vest covered in coloured patches and pins, with tattoos visible on your chest.

elizabeth-peralez.text: You have dark hair swept back into a sleek style with volume at the top. You wear purple lipstick and violet eyeshadow, long dangling earrings with a pale blue sheen, and a dark metallic neck collar. Your top is white with a textured mauve-grey panel across the chest.

evelyn-parker.text: You have dark-blue hair cut in straight bangs across your forehead, with freckles across your nose and cheeks and dark lipstick. You wear a pink and teal fur collar over a glossy black jacket, with a sparkly patterned bodice underneath and a thin choker-style necklace.

frank-nostra.text: You have short brown hair swept back from your forehead and a trimmed reddish-brown beard. Thin wire cyberware with small gold tips runs from your temple past your eye and along your cheek. You wear a dark, glossy collared shirt with dark panel details at the shoulders.

hanako-arasaka.text: You have dark hair pulled back tightly from your face. You wear dark red-brown eyeshadow and deep maroon lipstick. Your outfit is a white high-necked mesh top with gold trim, under a white jacket with reddish-brown shoulder panels and a small gold pin on the lapel.

iris-tanner.text: You have long dark red-brown hair with the right side of your head shaved into an undercut. You wear long silver feather-shaped earrings and have light freckles across your cheeks. Blue-and-silver goggles with red X markings hang at your chest over a dark grey hooded top and a dark denim-look vest.

jackie-welles.text: You have a close-cropped head with the sides shaved short and a little hair left on top. Dark cybernetic lines with small gold ports run across your cheeks, nose and jaw, and a small red light sits behind your right ear. You wear a dark jacket with a red-lined high collar and a gold cross on a gold chain.

jake-estevez.text: You have a muscular build visible in your arms and a camouflage bandana with white stars over your head. You have a tattoo on your upper arm, leather wristbands, and a black device strapped to your upper right arm. Your outfit is a sleeveless peach-orange vest with teal trim over a grey tank top, grey-and-black camo cargo trousers, and dark boots.

jefferson-peralez.text: You have dark hair slicked back from your forehead. You wear a dark jacket over a grey-blue collared shirt with a pale panel running down the front.

jesse.text: You have a stocky, broad-shouldered build, short dark red-brown hair swept back from your forehead, and a full dark beard. You wear dark sunglasses, a gold chain, and a pink and purple striped shirt open and loose with the sleeves rolled up over a white tank top. Your shorts are very short, your ankle socks have orange bands, and you wear dark slip-on shoes. You have a cluster of dark tattoos on your right thigh.

johnny-silverhand.text: You have shoulder-length dark hair swept back from a bearded face, with mirrored aviator sunglasses. Your right arm is a bulky chrome cyberarm with exposed plating from shoulder to hand, and dark smudged markings show on your left forearm. You wear a sleeveless dark tactical vest with a dog-tag chain at your neck and a heavy silver ring on your finger.

joss-kutcher.text: You have dark hair swept back from your face and falling past your shoulders. You wear a blue denim vest with a black leather collar over a red knit sweater and a white top underneath. A silver-metal pendant hangs at your neck.

judy-alvarez.text: You have green and pink hair, shaved short on one side and swept over the other, with a cyberport behind your ear. You have red roses tattooed on your neck and chest, a fire-truck tattoo on your chest, and tattoo sleeves on your arms. You wear a light grey tank top.

kerry-eurodyne.text: You have spiked, swept-back hair with the sides shaved and a short stubbly beard. Your arms are covered in tattoos, and you wear a black studded leather vest over a white tank top, with layered gold chains and studded leather wristbands.

liam-northom.text: You have bleached blond hair with a faint green tint, cut short at the sides and swept up on top, with round wire-framed glasses and a small earring. You wear a beaded gold and dark necklace, a white T-shirt, and a dark jacket embossed with a gold pattern and metallic gold and teal panels.

lina-malina.text: You have spiky magenta and violet hair, with the side of your head shaved and patterned in violet. You wear rimless round tinted glasses, a gold septum ring, and a cross-shaped dangling earring. Your jewellery includes a red-and-gold square-link choker with layered gold chains, and you wear plum lipstick.

lizzy-wizzy.text: You have a polished chrome face and head with a mirror-like finish, and magenta hair falling to your shoulders. You wear a black choker and a black top under a jacket with a magenta and teal fur collar.

lucy-kushinada.text: You have pale skin, pale pearly eyes and a short, square-cut silver-white bob with an undercut. A longer lock at the front is tinted pink and teal toward the ends. Cyberware ports dot your body. You wear a dark grey jumpsuit with red accents, white shorts and a white jacket, with a black belt that holds a cyberdeck and black armoured knee-high boots with red accents.

mama-welles.text: You have shoulder-length brown hair with side-swept bangs and a lined, weathered face. You wear a red knit top under a dark brown leather vest with stitched pockets.

mark-bana.text: You have a tall, sturdy build and short dark hair swept up on top and cut close at the sides, with stubble along your jaw. You have a metal implant plate across the bridge of your nose, a small implant at one temple, a dark curved line under your chin, and a dark cord necklace with a small device at the base of your throat. You wear a light V-neck shirt.

meredith-stout.text: You have auburn hair swept back from your forehead, with a thin cybernetic panel and circuit lines over your left temple and cheek. You wear a dark high-collared uniform jacket with grey shoulder plates and a small chest patch.

misty-olszewski.text: You have a short grey-green bob with blunt bangs, smoky dark eye makeup and dark lipstick. You wear a spiked black choker, a blue knit sweater and a layered cord necklace with a skull pendant.

mitch-anderson.text: You have a shaved head with dark hair left at the sides and back, and a metal plate set into your scalp above one temple. A metal chin plate with a visible seam sits below your stubbled jaw. You wear a green sleeveless vest with a teal collar and dark padded shoulder straps.

mr-hands.text: You have dark hair with grey streaks swept back, a grey moustache and a grey-and-dark beard. A cybernetic panel with small gold-tipped ports runs along your right temple and cheek. You wear a brown patterned jacket with a dark wave-pattern lapel over a white shirt and a thin dark tie.

muamar-reyes.text: You have straight black hair cut in a heavy fringe that sits just above your eyebrows, with long side pieces falling past your jaw. You wear a gold chain with a cross pendant and a blue pendant at your neck. Your blue pinstriped jacket is open over bare skin, with a tattoo visible on your chest.

nancy-hartley.text: You have shoulder-length wavy grey-blonde hair and a camera-like cybernetic eye fitted over one eye, while the eye on the other side glows red. You wear dark lipstick and a dark beaded choker. Your outfit is a sleeveless blue denim jacket over a grey top printed with red lettering.

nele-springer.text: You have shoulder-length blonde hair with choppy bangs and freckles across your face. You wear a dark green leather jacket with black leather shoulders and sleeves, a rust-red knit top underneath, and black leather trousers. A dark red high-necked collar sits at your throat, and you have a slim build.

nix.text: You have very short light blond hair in a buzz cut and wear round, dark-tinted glasses. Your vest is padded black with yellow honeycomb-patterned fabric showing between the panels. You have a broad, solid build.

ozob-bozo.text: You have a bald crown with dark hair kept at the sides and back, and a broad face. A dark band runs across your nose and cheeks, and you wear a dark padded collar over a dark blue top with a white chain necklace.

paco-torres.text: You are muscular, with short, close-cropped dark hair and a dark tattoo on your upper arm. You wear a yellow-green BARGHEST tactical vest with black pouches over bare arms, a grey camo-print scarf at the neck, and black fingerless gloves. A black armored pauldron with yellow markings sits on one shoulder.

padre-ibarra.text: You are bald, with dark ink tattoos across your scalp, forehead and neck, including the word Repent across your forehead. You have a grey moustache and wear a dark green collared shirt with a heavy gold chain over a dark jacket.

panam-palmer.text: You have dark hair pulled up into a high bun of braids, with loose strands framing your face and dark eye makeup. You wear an olive knit off-the-shoulder top with a wide tan belt and copper buckle, and a patch on one sleeve.

pepe-najarro.text: You have dark hair slicked back and a full dark beard. You wear a dark sleeveless vest, a heavy silver chain with an ornate cross pendant, and a silver cuff bracelet on your wrist.

placide.text: You have dark hair with a pale streak across the crown and a cybernetic fitting at one temple with a small green light. You have warm brown skin and wear a tan leather jacket over a red top.

r3n0.text: You have silver-grey hair spiked up on top with the sides shaved close. You wear a dark jacket with a white front panel over a dark top.

rachel-casich.text: You have copper-red hair swept up into a short crest with the sides shaved. You wear round gold-rimmed glasses and a red-brown choker, with a dark jacket and white collar panel.

regina-jones.text: You have dark hair swept back and wear a black eyepatch over your right eye. You wear a black tactical vest over a light blue shirt, with a small gold cross on a thin chain.

rita-wheeler.text: You have chrome cyberware arms with pink and cyan accents, spikes along your forearms and knuckles, and sharp prosthetic nails. A Mox mark is tattooed across your upper chest. You have a punk look and carry a baseball bat.

river-ward.text: You have close-cropped dark hair and a brown fur-trimmed vest over a red shirt. A cybernetic eye with a black lens sits in your left eye socket, and you wear a silver feather pendant on a chain and a small drop earring in one ear.

robert-wilson.text: You have a heavy build with a balding crown, dark hair at the sides, and a thick moustache with a short chin beard. You wear a dark grey tank top under an open brown utility jacket with pockets, with a bullet on a cord around your neck and a holstered pistol at your side.

rogue-amendiares.text: You have long dark hair with blue-tinted strands, swept up on one side. Dark lines are painted across your cheeks, and you wear a bright yellow jacket with a black SURVIVE label across the chest over a dark high collar.

sandra-dorsett.text: You have sandy-blonde hair with the sides shaved close and thin dark marks running down your cheeks below each eye. You wear a black suit jacket over a cream high-collared shirt, with a gold name badge on the lapel.

santiago.text: You have long, dark, swept-back hair and a full brown beard. You wear round dark-tinted sunglasses and an orange-and-black tiger-stripe jacket with buckled straps and patches on the chest.

saul-bright.text: You have shoulder-length dark hair and a short dark beard. You wear a dark blue padded armored vest with a silver emblem on the chest over a grey top.

sergei-karasinsky.text: You wear a dark cap and glowing cyan-tinted eyewear, with red X marks across a glitch-patterned face. You have a dark green ribbed leather jacket over an orange sweater and a gold chain at your neck.

shank.text: You have a lean build, tan skin, and short dark hair swept up and back from your forehead, with clear safety glasses in dark frames. You wear a sleeveless grey-green camouflage tactical vest over a blue top, with a thin chain at your neck and a lettered tattoo across your chest. A cyan and black band wraps one forearm, and the other forearm is cyberware with a teal-lit hand. A wide tool belt with pouches holds a grey leather work apron at your waist, over baggy dark trousers and tan sandals.

solomon-reed.text: You have short, close-cropped dark hair and a stubbled beard. A thin silver cyberware line runs over your forehead and temple with small red lights along it, and you wear a quilted maroon-collared dark jacket over a light blue shirt, with a glowing ring pendant on a black cord.

songbird.text: You have a magenta bob with a blunt fringe and dark cybernetic lines running across your forehead, nose and cheeks. A black cyber collar sits at your throat, and you wear a grey-beige sleeveless wrap top trimmed with copper.

spider-murphy.text: You wear a dark grey combat helmet with a red-tinted visor display over your eyes and grey cheek guards on each side of your jaw. You have a dark grey jacket with red straps and buckles.

steven-santos.text: You have short dark hair, wire-framed glasses, and a green cybernetic implant at one temple. You wear a grey-black ribbed leather jacket open over a white tank top with a black belt.

t-bug.text: You have a shaved head and dark skin, with dark eye makeup and a defined brow. You wear a black fitted bodysuit with silver buckles and straps across the shoulders and chest.

takemura.text: You have slicked-back grey-black hair and a short beard along your jaw. Cybernetic cabling and panels run from your neck up along your jaw and cheek, and you wear a white layered jacket with pale stripes.

thompson.text: You have swept-back grey-white hair and a blue-grey cybernetic eye on one side of your face. You wear a long light grey coat with textured lapels over a dusty pink crew-neck shirt, with two dog tags on a chain.

viktor-vektor.text: You have short dark hair swept back and dark wraparound sunglasses. You wear an open-collared dark button-up shirt with a small pendant on a cord and a stethoscope hanging around your neck.

wakako-okada.text: You have grey hair pulled back into a low bun and round gold-rimmed glasses. You wear a dark grey open-collared robe with red trim, and dark tattoo designs show across both shoulders.

yorinobu-arasaka.text: You have short dark hair swept up and back and wear dark rectangular sunglasses. You wear a black-and-white patterned shirt with an open collar and a thin gold chain.
